pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Hammer$() and $(l)Red Matter Hammer$() are heavy mining hammers. Craft the Dark Matter Hammer from Dark Matter and a diamond, then upgrade it into the Red Matter Hammer.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge. The hammer hits hard: thirteen attack damage for Dark Matter, fourteen for Red Matter.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Right-click a block to dig out an area in front of you, with depth and size growing with charge.$(li)Charges up to add bonus attack damage.$(li)Mines Dark and Red Matter blocks almost instantly.$(li)The extra hit from charging no longer ignores armor in this version.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() server.items.disableAllRadiusMining.
